expectations.text: Response provides an applyCanvasActions update action with shapeType: 'iframe', state: 'live', and a url field to flip a building iframe to live.
expectations.evidence: Response shows exact code: `{ type: "update", shapeId: "my-frame-1", updates: { shapeType: "iframe", state: "live", url: "https://.../__mockup/preview/ui/ComponentOne" } }` inside an applyCanvasActions call.

expectations.text: Response specifies the mockup-sandbox URL pattern without a port number: https://${REPLIT_DOMAINS}/__mockup/preview/{folder}/{ComponentName}
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly shows: `https://${REPLIT_DOMAINS}/__mockup/preview/{folder}/{ComponentName}` and warns 'do NOT use the main app dev URL... Always use /__mockup/preview/{folder}/{ComponentName}'.

expectations.text: Response states that all frames must be 'live' before calling focusCanvasShapes — a mix of building and live states signals an incomplete build.
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'Every frame must be "live" before you call focusCanvasShapes' and explains a mix 'signals an incomplete build to judges, even when the underlying work is finished'.

expectations.text: Response mentions obtaining REPLIT_DOMAINS at runtime (e.g. via 'echo $REPLIT_DOMAINS') to construct the full https:// URL.
expectations.evidence: Response shows: 'Get your domain: `echo $REPLIT_DOMAINS`' as a distinct step, and notes 'The mockup-sandbox URL uses REPLIT_DOMAINS (no port number). Retrieve it at runtime'.
